environment_profiles.reference_prompt: A cluttered, dimly lit lighthouse attic with old trunks, faded navigational maps, and cobweb-covered lanterns, all covered in a thick layer of dust, with soft, diffused light peeking through the small attic window, casting a warm glow on the nostalgic, forgotten treasures.

A cozy, misty lighthouse library with old bookshelves lined with leather-bound tomes, brass navigational instruments on a nearby desk, and a warm, golden light spilling in through the window, casting a sense of intimacy and scholarly pursuit, as if the keeper has just stepped away from their research.

A cozy, stormy lighthouse living room at night, with flickering candles casting shadows on the walls, old armchairs gathered around a crackling fireplace, and the sound of the storm raging outside, as the keeper sits in comfort, listening to the old radio broadcast mysterious messages from vanished ships.

A serene, majestic lighthouse lantern room at sunset, with prismatic glass refracting the warm, golden light, a brass lantern standing tall, and a breathtaking coastal view stretching out to the horizon, as the keeper stands at the edge of the room, taking in the beauty of the fading day.

A peaceful, contemplative lighthouse window at dusk, with an old window frame, a worn wooden sill, and a fading coastal view, as the last remnants of daylight cast a warm, gentle glow on the scene, inviting the keeper to sit, reflect, and listen to the whispers of the past.
